keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One or more search terms (job title, skill or company). Every keyword is searched separately and duplicates are removed.

keyword.title: Single keyword (optional)
keyword.description: Shortcut for one search term. Added to the Keywords list.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: One or more locations, for example Norway, Oslo, Stockholm or Remote. Each keyword is searched in each location.

location.title: Single location (optional)
location.description: Shortcut for one location. Added to the Locations list.

geoId.title: LinkedIn geoId (optional)
geoId.description: Exact LinkedIn location id (for example 103819153 for Norway). Overrides name-based matching when you need precision.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Only jobs posted within this period.

jobType.title: Job type
jobType.description: Only these employment types. Leave empty for all.

experienceLevel.title: Experience level
experienceLevel.description: Only these seniority levels. Leave empty for all.

workType.title: Workplace type
workType.description: On-site, remote or hybrid. Leave empty for all.

easyApply.title: Easy Apply only
easyApply.description: Only include jobs with LinkedIn's Easy Apply option.

under10Applicants.title: Under 10 applicants
under10Applicants.description: Only include jobs that have fewer than 10 applicants so far.

companyName.title: Company names
companyName.description: Keep only jobs whose company name contains one of these names (case-insensitive). Applied after scraping, so combine with a higher limit.

companyId.title: Company IDs
companyId.description: Only jobs from these LinkedIn company IDs. Applied by LinkedIn itself, so it is exact and fast.

titleInclude.title: Title must include
titleInclude.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains all words of at least one of these phrases (case-insensitive, word order does not matter).

titleExclude.title: Title must not include
titleExclude.description: Drop jobs whose title contains all words of at least one of these phrases (case-insensitive, word order does not matter).

skipJobId.title: Skip job IDs
skipJobId.description: Job IDs to leave out, for example jobs you collected in an earlier run.

limit.title: Maximum number of jobs
limit.description: Total jobs to save across all searches.

maxPages.title: Maximum result pages per search
maxPages.description: Safety limit. Each page holds 10 jobs and LinkedIn shows about 1,000 results per search.

includeDetails.title: Fetch full job details
includeDetails.description: Adds the full description (text and HTML), seniority, employment type, industries, applicants, company ID and apply link. Turn off for the fastest basic listing.

maxRequestsPerMinute.title: Maximum requests per minute
maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Speed limit that keeps LinkedIn from blocking you. The default works well with Apify Proxy; lower it if you see rate-limit warnings.

urlParam.title: Extra URL parameters
urlParam.description: Advanced: extra LinkedIn search parameters as key=value, for example f_SB2=4 for a salary bracket.

startUrls.title: LinkedIn search URLs
startUrls.description: Optional. Paste normal LinkedIn job search URLs (linkedin.com/jobs/search/?...). Their filters are reused.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: LinkedIn rate-limits single IP addresses. Residential Apify Proxy is recommended for anything beyond a few dozen jobs.

includeCompanyProfile.title: Include company profile (slower)
includeCompanyProfile.description: Also read each company's public LinkedIn page once and add website, industry, size, followers and headquarters when LinkedIn serves them. Best effort; needs a working proxy.

debugSaveHtml.title: Debug: save raw detail pages
debugSaveHtml.description: Save the raw HTML of the first N job detail pages to the key-value store (for diagnosing missing fields).
